name: questionfix.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 page has no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: www.questionfix.com scores 59 out of 100 (D). 10 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 17 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 1 page has no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 162 elements on /, /top-5-leakproof-pullup-diapers-the-best-choices-for-dry-stressfree-days, /the-ultimate-guide-to-business-class-air-travel-is-it-worth-it, for example…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 17 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /Contact. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The page fits a 390 px phone screen
The start page arrived in 224 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
